comment: Kernel tests (harness-ui/tests) that cannot run in the CLI tree, each with the reason. Checked 07/10/2026: every file below passes in the desktop integration worktree (AVM-kernel-r, 091300e95, with the desktop's own server and frontend) except http-routes-batch-delete, which is a CLI-only legacy file; none exercises the vendored kernel (src/, context-engine). Realigned 08/10/2026 to the desktop tip 156689e4e: the new desktop tests that need the desktop frontend or scripts are listed under `files`; `tests` lists single tests (matched by name, `--test-skip-pattern`) that either need a desktop file or are RED ON THE DESKTOP TIP TOO, reproduced in AVM-integrazione-r4 with an isolated TEMP. each name must still exist in a test file (the script fails otherwise). Remove an entry when its test passes here. Realigned again 08/10/2026 to the desktop tip 507c47f62 (r4 cd7af4ca3): the desktop fixed its four reds (BC76-07, BC49, F-007-ONE-KILL-PATH, SPAWN-AMBIENTE-01), so their entries are gone. Realigned 13/10/2026 to the desktop tip r4 de8f33317 (per-file three-way, base 507c47f62): two more files and one test, below, with "13/10/2026" in their reason; session-registry.test.mjs is the desktop's copy again (483 tests) with one CLI adaptation, the dictionary comparison is skipped where frontend/src/i18n/testi is not in the tree. Realigned 14/10/2026 to r4 e1cbc26f4: r4 brought 72 new test files; the ones that need the desktop's server.mjs, frontend/, desktop/ or scripts/ are below with "r4 e1cbc26f4" in their reason, those that also prove src/ reported to the desktop to be split. Realigned 15/10/2026 to r4 962a78772 (the cures of the CLI's 0.6.4 findings, permessoPerIlModello): the desktop split the 13 files that mixed src/ and desktop checks; their src/ halves run here, the `-desktop` halves are excluded. Realigned 16/10/2026 to r4 c9f57920b (the four kernel cures asked by the CLI: token counter, signal owner, OpenAI names on a chosen address, the split of three tests): aperti-minori, titolo-regola-unica-revisione and titolo-sessione-revisione now run their src/ halves here, the `-desktop` halves are excluded. Realigned 16/10/2026 to r4 9719025fe (0.6.8: the counter fallback in the contract, file refusal reasons, duplicate names, one agent name, the refusal reason of a closed question, instant compaction for the legacy engine, terminals without a session): three new `-desktop` halves are excluded. Realigned 16/10/2026 to r4 d130a450f (0.6.8, after the first review: context full retried through the real adapter, the service closes automatic summaries, the agent name in the result envelope, nobody in front per turn, Stop before the request is sent): nomi-doppi-dal-server-revisione-2 runs here again, its -desktop half and fermata-prima-dell-invio-desktop are excluded. «One line», step 3 (11/11/2026): the CLI now lives on the line, where the desktop frontend, server.mjs, scripts and native files are present; every file excluded for their absence was run under the gate's conditions (cwd harness-ui, the keyring trip wire, the skip patterns) and the green ones left this list; http-routes-batch-delete.test.mjs is not on the line any more. What stays is red here for the reason written beside it. 0.7.0 block 1, item 5 (21/11/2026): the 58 single tests listed here were run one by one, three times each, under the gate's conditions (cwd harness-ui, the keyring trip wire, a private TEMP, a network spy) on the 0.7.0 candidate 2357e7eed: 57 were green 3 of 3 and left this list (the «older copy» reason no longer held: the line carries the desktop's current files); 1 stays with the reason measured that day.

files.server-workflow-wiring.test.mjs: red on the line under a loaded machine (CPU 80-100%): WF-SESSION-PROPOSE-APPROVE-RESTART fails its after hook with EPERM removing its temp folder (tests/aiuto/rimuovi-cartella-di-prova.mjs:82), then the file does not end within 600 s; tests 1, 3 and 4 pass, so the old reason (the CLI's older server.mjs) is no longer true; recheck on an idle machine (11/11/2026, step 3)
files.temp-nessun-residuo.test.mjs: DESK-TEMP-2 is red only under the keyring trip wire: frontend/tests/unit/ripresa-isolamento.test.mjs:77 (RIPRESA-R0-PORTACHIAVI) loads the real keyring adapter in a child, which the wire refuses at resolve @napi-rs/keyring; recheck when branch k (0cf0f34d3, which changes frontend/scripts/ripresa-run.mjs) enters (11/11/2026, step 3)
files.computer-use-segno-battito-filo.test.mjs: drives the DESKTOP shell's desktop/segno-finestra.mjs (creaSegnoFinestre), whose older copy in this tree has no `acceso`: 7/7 red here, 7/7 green on the files of desktop 0.2.3 bb6d3799a; the package does not ship desktop/ (18/11/2026, CLI 0.6.16 on the core of 0.2.3)
files.lanciatore-scarica-12-11.test.mjs: imports the DESKTOP's scripts/scarica-lanciatore.mjs and reads native/lanciatore/ and the repository's .github workflow, none of which this tree or the CLI package carries (18/11/2026, CLI 0.6.16 on the core of 0.2.3)

tests.CP-14: il server vero: catalogo-pubblico.test.mjs: its control half (without TALOS_HARNESS_UI_CATALOGO_PUBBLICO) lets the desktop's server.mjs fetch openrouter.ai for real; under the CLI's isolated runs a network spy refuses that request, so the test is red 3 of 3 (measured 21/11/2026 on the 0.7.0 candidate 2357e7eed). A CLI test never reaches a real host: it stays excluded until its control half answers from a fake of the same process.
tests.R21-D1-01: r21-attese-e-sveglia.test.mjs: the turn starts a background command (node, 400 ms) inside the test folder, and the test removes the folder as soon as the turn ends; while that child is alive Windows refuses the removal (EPERM, which rmSync does not retry: tests/aiuto/rimuovi-cartella-di-prova.mjs). Green 27 of 27 here with the gate's flags, stdin and a private short TEMP, red on the loaded runner of the second public dry run (45262063647, 23/11/2026). The same file runs whole in the release job's desktop gate (the whole server suite) and in ci.yml's desktop job; the cure belongs to the test (wait for the child, tests/aiuto/attendi-figli-sulla-cartella.mjs) and is listed for desktop 0.2.6.
tests.R21-D1-02: r21-attese-e-sveglia.test.mjs: the same background child as R21-D1-01, without the wake-up: the same EPERM in the cleanup on the loaded runner, the same coverage in the desktop gate, the same cure listed for desktop 0.2.6.
tests.C6BIS-GIRO-02: riserva-del-riassunto-c6bis.test.mjs: the turn prepares the summary in the background (a git child on the test folder; tests/aiuto/attendi-figli-sulla-cartella.mjs explains it) and the cleanup meets it alive: EPERM. Intermittent on desktop 0.2.4 too (desktop list for 0.2.6, item 10); red on the second public dry run (45262063647, 23/11/2026), green here. The file runs whole in the release job's desktop gate (the whole server suite).
tests.C6BIS-GIRO-04: riserva-del-riassunto-c6bis.test.mjs: the same background git child and EPERM as C6BIS-GIRO-02; intermittent on desktop 0.2.4 too (desktop list for 0.2.6, item 10); covered by the desktop gate.
tests.C6BIS-GIRO-10: riserva-del-riassunto-c6bis.test.mjs: the same background git child and EPERM as C6BIS-GIRO-02, red on the second public dry run; covered by the desktop gate; the cure is listed for desktop 0.2.6.
